description: Multi-step agentic + multi-constraint: write code, ACTUALLY RUN it via code_execution, report the verified output, and state complexity. Role headroom: coder / tester / reviewer.

input.message: Write a Python function fib_sum(n) that returns the sum of the first n Fibonacci numbers (starting 1, 1, 2, 3, 5...). Then ACTUALLY RUN it with the code_execution tool for n=30 and report the exact number it printed. Also state the time complexity in Big-O notation. Your answer must include: the code, the executed result number, and the Big-O.
